# Czech — 2021

> Benchmark chips for Czech Republic cut from the 2021 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection cz.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/cz_2021_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/cz_2021_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/cz_2021_fields.parquet)
- [Field polygons after the class filter](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/cz_2021_fields_filtered.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/cz_2021/items.parquet)
